island.trayEmpty: Drop files onto the island to keep them here
island.allHiddenEditing: All widgets are hidden. Add them back below.
island.editNote: Drag a widget to move it, also into the second row. Hidden widgets appear here.

media.name: Now Playing
media.description: Cover, playback controls and progress of the current track

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.description: Camera preview, off as soon as the island closes

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: The week around today, with events from your calendar link or file

tray.name: Files Tray
tray.description: Drop files on the island to keep them at hand

calendar.startsSoon: Starts in less than a minute
calendar.endsSoon: ends in less than a minute
calendar.addSource: Add a calendar link or file

settings.sourceDescription: The secret iCal address of a Google, Outlook or iCloud calendar, or the path to an .ics file. It stays on this computer.
settings.refreshDescription: Google updates the feed itself only every few hours. Files are read again as soon as they change.
settings.endedTodayDescription: Earlier days always show their events, dimmed.

errors.scheme: Use an https:// or webcal:// link, or the path to an .ics file.
errors.fullPath: Use the full path to the file, such as C:\Users\you\calendar.ics.
errors.notALink: Paste the iCal link of the calendar or the full path to an .ics file.
errors.notACalendarFile: This file is not a calendar. Use an .ics file.
errors.webPage: This link opens a web page, not a calendar. Copy the iCal (.ics) address from the calendar's settings.
errors.invalidFileLink: The file link is not valid.
errors.fileNotFound: Lizun cannot find this file. Check the path.
errors.fileNotAllowed: Lizun is not allowed to read this file.
errors.folder: This is a folder. Use the path to the .ics file itself.
errors.tooLarge: The calendar is larger than {size} MB.
errors.refused: The calendar service refused the link. Use the secret address in iCal format.
errors.notFound: Nothing found at this link. Check that it is the calendar's iCal address.
errors.httpError: The calendar service answered with HTTP error {code}.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the calendar. Lizun will try again in a few minutes.

clipboard.empty: Copy text, a picture or files and they show up here
clipboard.filesGone: These files were moved or deleted

errors.loginItem: Could not change the login item: {error}
errors.fileDialog: Could not open the file dialog: {error}
errors.port: The port must be a number from {min} to {max}.
errors.limit: The limit must be a number from {min} to {max}.

general.title: General
general.languageHint: Language of the island and the settings. Widgets can follow it too.
general.launchAtLoginHint: Start Lizun when you sign in to Windows.
general.alwaysHint: The mini island stays at the top of the screen while it has something to show, such as music, files in the tray or a widget activity.
general.autoHideHint: Shows after the island closes or when something changes, such as a new track, then hides.
general.hiddenHint: Nothing is shown while the island is closed.
general.delayHint: How long the mini island stays, from {min} to {max} seconds.
general.showOnMusicHint: The mini island appears when a track starts, pauses or changes.
general.edgeNote: In every mode, point at the top edge of the screen to open the island.
general.hoverDelayHint: How long to hold the pointer at the top edge before the island opens, from {min} to {max} seconds. A longer delay prevents accidental opens.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts work in any app. Use a key with two modifiers, such as Ctrl+Shift+K, a side mouse button (alone or with modifiers) or F13–F24. Single keys, the main mouse buttons and the wheel cannot be used, nor combinations Windows and apps need.
shortcuts.toggleIslandHint: Opened this way, it closes by itself after a few seconds unless you point at it.
shortcuts.recordingHint: Press the keys or a side mouse button. Esc cancels.
shortcuts.taken: Another app or Windows already uses this shortcut. Choose another one.
shortcuts.inUse: This shortcut is already set for “{action}”.
shortcuts.note: Music shortcuts control the player shown on the island. Shortcuts are off while one is being recorded.

refused.key: This key cannot be used: Windows and apps need it.
refused.modifier: Hold Ctrl, Alt or Win with the key, or use a side mouse button. Alone or with Shift, the key types or works in apps.
refused.oneModifier: Combinations with one modifier, such as Ctrl+C or Win+D, belong to Windows and apps. Add a second modifier.
refused.altGr: Ctrl+Alt with a letter, digit or sign types characters on many keyboard layouts. Use Ctrl+Shift or Alt+Shift, or add Win.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.moveHint: Move {name}. Use the up and down arrows.
widgets.orderNote: Drag to change the order; widgets dragged below "Row 2" go into the second row. You can also arrange widgets in the island itself with the pencil button.
widgets.rowHeadingHint: Widgets below are shown in the island under the ones above.
widgets.githubLink: Link to a widget on GitHub
widgets.fromComputer: Or from this computer. You can also drop it on this window.
widgets.checking: Getting the widget and checking it…
widgets.replaces: Replaces the installed version {version}. Its settings and data are kept.
widgets.sandbox: The widget runs in a sandbox and gets only what is listed above.
widgets.none: No widgets installed yet. Add one with a GitHub link, a zip archive or a folder.
widgets.drop: Drop a zip archive or a widget folder to install it
widgets.dropOne: Drop one widget at a time.
widgets.wasInstalled: {name} was installed and is in the island now.

media.title: Media
media.intro: Apps that appear in the Windows media controls show up on the island by themselves. Some browsers, such as Yandex Browser, do not publish their media there; the Lizun browser extension brings their tabs in.
media.browserMediaHint: Show music and videos that the Lizun extension finds in browser tabs.
media.portHint: The extension connects here; its popup has to show the same port. From {min} to {max}.
media.retrying: {error} Lizun keeps retrying; choose another port if it stays busy.
media.waiting: Waiting for the extension on port {port}.
media.installExtension: Install the {name} browser extension for Chrome, Yandex Browser, Edge, Opera or Firefox.
media.reloadTabs: Reload the tabs that were open before the extension was installed.
media.samePort: If you changed the port, enter {port} in the extension's popup as well.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.intro: Lizun keeps the text, pictures and files you copy in the Clipboard tab of the island; click an entry there to copy it again. Files are kept as links to where they are. The history stays on this computer.
clipboard.historyHint: Turning it off deletes the saved history.
clipboard.textHint: Text, links and paths copied as text.
clipboard.picturesHint: Screenshots and images copied from apps and browsers.
clipboard.filesHint: Files and folders copied in Explorer; only their paths are kept.
clipboard.kindsNote: A copy that holds several kinds counts as the first of files, text and pictures, so files copied together with their paths as text are skipped while files are off. Turning a kind off deletes its entries; one kind always stays on.
clipboard.limitHint: When the history is full, the oldest entry is deleted.
clipboard.private: Passwords and other text that apps mark as private, such as copies from password managers, are never saved. Texts over 1 MB are skipped.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Open-source dynamic island with installable widgets.

install.idTakenBundled: The widget uses the id {id}, which is taken by {name}: that widget comes with Lizun.
install.idTakenDev: The widget uses the id {id}, which is taken by {name}: that widget is in the repository's widgets folder.
install.notWaiting: This install is no longer waiting. Start it again.
install.onlyUser: Only widgets you installed can be removed.
install.folderWithoutManifest: This folder has no manifest.json. Choose the widget's own folder.
install.zipOrFolder: Choose a .zip archive or a widget folder.
install.noEntry: The widget has no {entry}, the page its manifest names as the entry.
install.folderInUse: Could not move the installed widget's folder ({error}). Close any program that has it open and try again.
install.usage: Paste a link to a widget on GitHub, such as https://github.com/owner/repo.
install.unsupportedLink: This GitHub link does not lead to a repository, a folder in one, a release or a zip file.
install.notFound: Nothing found at this link. Check it; widgets from private repositories cannot be installed.
install.httpError: GitHub answered with HTTP error {code}. Try again later.
install.archiveTooLarge: The archive is larger than {size} MB.
install.tooManyFiles: The widget has more than {count} files.
install.widgetTooLarge: The widget is larger than {size} MB.
install.notAZip: This is not a zip archive Lizun can read: {error}
install.noManifestInFolder: There is no manifest.json in the folder {folder}, so it holds no Lizun widget.
install.noManifest: There is no manifest.json here, so this is not a Lizun widget.
install.severalWidgets: There are several widgets here ({list}). Install one at a time: link to its folder on GitHub or choose that folder.

browser.portInUse: Port {port} is used by another app.
